```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(l1ou) # this needs to be downloaded from github

```

# Volume (size) analysis

```{r}
# Load the spore volume data
volume_data <- read_csv("spreadsheets/Sporelengthwidthvolume.csv")

# View the first few rows to confirm it's loaded correctly
head(volume_data)

```

# ADD THE NICHE TO PCA CHARTS 

```{r}
# Load the niche data (corrected path based on new upload)
niche_data <- read.csv("spreadsheets/Spores_Amanita_ecological_niche.csv")

# Add a new 'Ecology' column from niche_data to pca_scores_df_species
volume_niche_merged <- volume_data %>%
  mutate(Ecology = niche_data$Ecology[match(species, niche_data$species)])

write.csv(volume_niche_merged, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species_and_niche.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Create a new 'Ecology_label' column with readable names
volume_niche_merged <- volume_niche_merged %>%
  mutate(Ecology_label = case_when(
    Ecology == 1 ~ "Ectomycorrhizal (EM)",
    Ecology == 2 ~ "Saprotrophic (SAP)",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# Filter out rows where Ecology_label is NA
volume_niche_filtered <- volume_niche_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ecology_label))

# Convert Ecology_label to factor
volume_niche_filtered$Ecology_label <- factor(volume_niche_filtered$Ecology_label, 
                                              levels = c("Ectomycorrhizal (EM)", "Saprotrophic (SAP)"))

write.csv(volume_niche_filtered, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species_and_niche_filter.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

```{r}

# Define colors for the ecological niches
niche_colors <- c("Ectomycorrhizal (EM)" = "green", 
                  "Saprotrophic (SAP)" = "orange")

# Create the box and whisker plot with p-values
plot <- ggplot(volume_niche_filtered, aes(x = Ecology_label, y = estimated_volume, fill = Ecology_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 3, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +  # Add jittered points
  scale_fill_manual(values = niche_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Spore Volume by Ecological Niche",
    x = "Ecological Niche",
    y = "Estimated Spore Volume (µm³)",
    fill = "Ecological Niche"
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = Ecology_label), method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 6) +  # p-value
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",   # Hide redundant legend
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

# Print the plot
print(plot)

# Save the plot
ggsave("Spore_Volume_by_Niche_Boxplot.png", plot = plot, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```
